title: ExplorerCatalogScreen
responsibility: Lists components, helpers and services in searchable card grids, and shells, configs and models in tables.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.index
inputs.description: The index prop remains in the host object passed to ExplorerFrame; this component does not read it directly.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.head
inputs.description: The selected revision is passed as revision to entityCatalog while rows are derived for the current category.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.parent
inputs.description: The parent revision remains in the host object passed to ExplorerFrame; this component does not read it directly.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.scope
inputs.description: Only scope.commit is read here; it is serialized with route.branch and passed to ExplorerIndex as its scope prop.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.route
inputs.description: The current route supplies category to entityCatalog, ExplorerIndex and ExplorerCatalogItems, and supplies branch to the JSON scope passed to ExplorerIndex.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.entities
inputs.description: entityCatalog computes rows from host.entities for the current category, using host.lens.relations and host.head.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.lens
inputs.description: lens.relations is read by entityCatalog, and the full lens is passed to ExplorerCatalogItems; this component does not read other lens members directly.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.client
inputs.description: The revision client remains in the host object passed to ExplorerFrame; this component does not access it directly.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.mediaBase
inputs.description: The media base string is forwarded unchanged to ExplorerCatalogItems.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.onroute
inputs.description: The host navigation callback remains in the host object passed to ExplorerFrame; this component does not invoke it directly.

outputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.collection
outputs.description: Returns an hx-div marker with data-harness-component="harness-explorer-catalog-screen" around ExplorerFrame. Its child markup supplies ExplorerIndex the category, derived rows and JSON scope made from route.branch and scope.commit, then supplies ExplorerCatalogItems the listed rows, navigation, lens and mediaBase.

errors.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.callerError
errors.description: Exceptions raised by entityCatalog or by forwarded child content and callbacks are not caught or translated here, so they propagate through rendering.
